dct_description_sm: These data were collected as part of the ongoing program of the Polar Environment Atmospheric Research Laboratory (PEARL) at Eureka, Nunavut (80N, 86.4W).  PEARL is operated by the Canadian Network for the Detection of Atmospheric Change (CANDAC).  The mission of PEARL is to characterize the atmosphere in the altitude range of 0-100km and provide data for studies of air quality, ozone, dynamics/chemistry/energetics and climate change. This radar provides winds from 82-97 km, with 3 km steps.
dct_title_s: CANDAC/PEARL DataSet - Eureka Meteor Radar: winds 82-97 km and daily temperature
